newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela mulls fourth oil auction round - report.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela mulls fourth oil auction round - report.

text.p: Venezuela's Energy and Mines Ministry will instruct state oil company Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) to prepare a fourth bidding round of mature oil fields for 1998, financial daily Economia Hoy reported Thursday.
Citing unnamed government sources, the report said a decision on the viability of a fourth bidding round would be taken late this year.
"We want the new round to be smaller than the last one," the source was quoted as saying. About 10 fields could be offered, the source said.
Venezuela auctioned operating contracts for 18 mature fields to local and international companies last month in a highly competitive bidding round that brought in bids totaling over $2.1 billion.
